title: 2-Hour Celebrity Homes Tour: Hollywood, Beverly Hills and Bel Air
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your private 2-hour tour includes the celebrity homes of movie stars and the rich and famous!

View the magnificent mansions of many of your favorite celebrities.
They’re the homes of the rich and famous – the show biz legends, and the hot new stars of today’s hippest movies and TV shows.

As we drive through the exclusive communities of Beverly Hills, Holmby Hills and Bel-Air, you’ll be amazed by one fabulous mansion after another, including the Spelling Manor and the Playboy Mansion.

Some of these homes are worth more than $100 million. Words like lavish and extravagant don’t begin to describe these magnificent palaces –you’ll just have to see them for yourself.

Travel in a discreet luxury black SUV, and customize your tour by your interests. Each air-conditioned vehicle is equipped with a multi-media iPad to accompany your guide's many talking points. This tour is a solid 2 hours, and we've laid out a guesstimate on stops and travel time.
